verses.ar: مَزْمُورُ حَمْدٍ اِهْتِفِي لِلرَّبِّ يَا كُلَّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.kjv: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.web: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

verses.he: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
verses.ar: ٱعْبُدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ بِفَرَحٍ. ٱدْخُلُوا إِلَى حَضْرَتِهِ بِتَرَنُّمٍ.
verses.en: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.
verses.kjv: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.web: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

verses.he: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ *וְלֹא (וְלֹ֣ו) אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מֹּ֗ו וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوا أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ هُوَ ٱللهُ. هُوَ صَنَعَنَا، وَلَهُ نَحْنُ شَعْبُهُ وَغَنَمُ مَرْعَاهُ.
verses.en: Know ye that the LORD He is God; it is He that hath made us, and we our His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.
verses.kjv: Know ye that the LORD he [is] God: [it is] he [that] hath made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.web: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.he: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו ׀ בְּתֹודָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֹֽודוּ־לֹ֝֗ו בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَهُ بِحَمْدٍ، دِيَارَهُ بِٱلتَّسْبِيحِ. ٱحْمَدُوهُ، بَارِكُوا ٱسْمَهُ.
verses.en: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, and into His courts with praise; give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.
verses.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, [and] into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, [and] bless his name.
verses.web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

verses.he: כִּי־טֹ֣וב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּ֑ו וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ صَالِحٌ، إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتُهُ، وَإِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ أَمَانَتُهُ.
verses.en: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.
verses.kjv: For the LORD [is] good; his mercy [is] everlasting; and his truth [endureth] to all generations.
verses.web: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
